page.heading: Contract Price Schedules
page.caption: Date-windowed pricing layered on top of a supplier contract for multi-year escalation

empty.title: No price schedules yet
empty.message: Add a schedule period to layer multi-year pricing onto this contract.
empty.scheduledMessage: Future-dated schedules will appear here once added.
empty.activeMessage: The contract is using header pricing — no schedule is in effect right now.
empty.supersededMessage: Schedules whose window has passed will be archived here.
empty.cancelledMessage: Schedules cancelled before activation will appear here.

form.name: Schedule Name
form.nameInfo: Human-readable label for this pricing window. Often a year or renewal label.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional details about this pricing window...
form.supplierContractInfo: The supplier contract this pricing window applies to. Schedules are scoped to a single contract.
form.dateStartInfo: When this pricing window takes effect. Window is half-open: start is inclusive.
form.dateEndInfo: When this pricing window ends. Leave blank for the open-ended last bucket. Window is half-open: end is exclusive.
form.currencyInfo: ISO 4217 currency for prices in this schedule.
form.locationInfo: Optional location override. Defaults to the parent contract's location.
form.statusInfo: Lifecycle state. New schedules default to Scheduled and progress to Active when their window arrives.
form.notesPlaceholder: Internal notes about this pricing window...
form.notesInfo: Internal remarks only. Not visible to the supplier.

confirm.deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this schedule? This action cannot be undone.
confirm.activateMessage: Activating this schedule will supersede any currently-active schedule on the same contract. Continue?
confirm.supersedeMessage: Mark this schedule as superseded? Future cycles will fall back to header pricing or to the next active schedule.
confirm.cancelMessage: Cancelling this schedule prevents it from ever activating. This action cannot be undone.

info.openEnded: This schedule is open-ended (no end date). Only one open-ended schedule is allowed per contract.
info.activeNotice: This schedule is currently in effect for the parent contract.
info.supersededNotice: This schedule has been superseded and no longer affects pricing.
info.overlapBlocked: Schedule windows cannot overlap. Adjust the start or end date so this window fits cleanly between existing schedules.

lines.title: Schedule Lines
lines.empty: No schedule lines yet. Add lines to override per-line pricing for this window.

lineForm.supplierContractLineInfo: The line whose unit price is overridden during this window.
lineForm.unitPriceInfo: Per-unit price during this window, in the schedule's currency.
lineForm.minimumAmountInfo: For Minimum Commitment lines: the floor charged per cycle.
lineForm.quantityInfo: Optional committed quantity for blanket or minimum-commitment lines.
lineForm.cycleValueOverrideInfo: Optional cycle-length override. Most lines inherit the contract cycle.
lineForm.cycleUnitOverrideInfo: Optional cycle-unit override (day, week, month, year).

detail.title: Schedule Detail
detail.auditEmptyMessage: Activity logs for this schedule will appear here.

validation.end_before_start: End date must be after start date
validation.overlap_with_existing: This window overlaps an existing schedule on the same contract
validation.open_ended_already_exists: Only one open-ended schedule is allowed per contract
validation.active_already_exists: Another schedule is already active on this contract

errors.permissionDenied: You do not have permission to perform this action.
errors.invalidFormData: Invalid form data. Please check your inputs and try again.
errors.not_found: Price schedule with ID "{entityId}" not found
errors.cannotDelete: Cannot delete — this schedule is currently active or has dependent lines.
errors.inUse: Cannot delete — this schedule is referenced by existing records.
errors.overlap_detected: Schedule windows overlap; adjust dates and retry
